content.short: Blend provides per-user on-chain accounts with screening and controls, plus risk-rated yield.
content.description: Blend gives each end user their own on-chain account with screening, reporting and controls built in, then layers risk-rated yield on top, all non-custodially through a single SDK. Monad's documentation lists it under earn and yield. The per-user account model is what makes the compliance story workable, since pooled custody is where most consumer yield products run into trouble.
content.meta: Blend provides per-user on-chain accounts with built-in controls and risk-rated yield, via one SDK.
